cases.name: 4986fcdb_nordic
cases.prompt: A cozy and comfortable Nordic-style living room bathed in natural soft light, featuring a clean white backdrop with blush pink and vibrant orange accents, matte finishes, and geometric wall art. In the foreground on the left, a low coffee table rests on a soft rug beside a plush fabric upholstered sofa backed by a solid wall, with a small side table nearby. Cute stuffed animal toys rest on the seating, adding warmth. A single upholstered accent armchair with armrests sits centrally in the foreground. On the right in the mid-ground, a tall minimalist bookshelf provides storage. A stylish screen cabinet buffers the entrance, while a mirror is subtly positioned away from direct line of sight from the doorway.
